response_transfer: At L5 or L6 final query, swap attention/MLP/both module perturbation responses across contexts at fixed local source state. Retain recipient zero-delta module baseline. Joint arm clamps both outputs using original captured responses, not a recomputed MLP response after attention intervention.
design: Cross surrounding same/different-key prompt with native same/different-key second-source pre-MLP L2 residual state. Add identical delta*W_h*V at that residual. Compare each perturbation to its own crossed baseline. Freeze item/format/query pairing.
prediction: Response follows transplanted local state if local geometry explains conditioning, or surrounding context if later readers/other token states matter; interaction between them is possible.
limitations: Hybrid local-state substitutions are diagnostic, not guaranteed on-manifold. State swap changes the entire local residual, not a semantic gate. Other token states/native context unchanged.
